body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature or object within 5 units would move, fall, or be forcibly moved.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Alter that movement by up to 2 units. You may gain 1 Strain to alter it by 1 additional unit.

surges.html: Increase this Reaction's range by 2 units or ignore line of sight to a creature you can locate.
Increase any movement, barrier, or forced-movement value in this Reaction by 1.
